checks.name: four Agent strategies share one E contract
empty native catalog means wait or explicit task completion, never a fake action
known pending effects need not force all Agents to wait
a blocked child choice wakes a boundary Agent
facade and internal scheduling expose different histories
boundary facade supports real reference input-to-source submission
facade rejects malformed requests before normalization
stale boundary views cannot be rebound to the latest source
stale observation is not silently rebound
request retransmission does not execute twice
unknown delivery blocks a new submission
Stop blocks future input without deleting pending effects
cross-product combinations not in the current relation are rejected
ambiguous semantic proposal is not resolved by first-match
transport repeats do not advance memory; actual revisits do
missing event and changed generation require an explicit new segment
event during inference is replayed at registration
already-true level condition differs from waiting for a new edge
events after the absolute basis deadline cannot restart the wait budget
control abort wins before result sealing; replay keeps the sealed result
retention gaps and past matches are not current-state assertions
only registered own predicates and declared event kinds are accepted
basis clock cannot be shifted to extend an old observation deadline
empty, interior-gap and duplicate buffers cannot assert quiet timeout
10000 catalog entries remain available without 10000 model scores

examples.caveat: Host setup and this reference resolve scan are O(N); this is not neural generation or a sublinear performance claim.

limitations: Not a production port, complete native simulator, learned M2, language model, RL run or Human data qualification.
Await is evaluated over a supplied deterministic event history; no concurrent broker, native capture or real timer is exercised.
Boundary readiness is a fixture fact; no native quiescence or H capture accuracy is proved.
All protocols and consumers use synthetic public objects; no private corpus or proprietary card text is accessed.
Counts refer to toy-model callbacks; no latency, token, GPU-cost or strategy-quality result is measured.
